illuminated-signage.title: Illuminated Signage
illuminated-signage.shortDescription: Lit signs and lettering that keep your business visible day and night.

We build every sign around your logo and your space, with lettering and shapes that read clearly from a distance. Design, production and installation are all handled in-house, start to finish.

exterior-signage.title: Exterior Signage
exterior-signage.shortDescription: Outdoor advertising built to grab attention and handle the weather.

print.title: Print
print.shortDescription: Sharp, accurate colour for everything from business cards to building-sized prints.

window-film.title: Window Film
window-film.shortDescription: Decorative, branded and privacy film for storefronts, offices and glass doors.
window-film.description: The glass in your storefront or office is valuable advertising and design space. Window film lets you display your brand and offers, or add privacy without losing natural light. Every sheet is cut to size and applied with care.

wall-murals.title: Wall Murals
wall-murals.shortDescription: Made-to-measure printed murals that completely transform a wall.
wall-murals.description: A single wall can change the character of an entire space. We print murals to your wall's exact dimensions — from our design collection, your own photos, or your brand's graphics. A fitting solution for homes and businesses alike.
features: Branded walls for offices, stores and shops
Murals for living rooms, bedrooms and kids' rooms

vehicle-wrapping.title: Vehicle Wrapping
vehicle-wrapping.shortDescription: Full and partial wraps that give your vehicle a new look or turn it into a moving ad.
vehicle-wrapping.description: Your vehicle can get a new colour without a repaint, or advertise your business everywhere it drives. We match the design to your vehicle's model and apply the film with care to every detail, for private vehicles and business fleets alike.

FaqSection.title: Questions we hear before every project.

f1.question: How long does a typical signage project take?
f1.answer: Small interior signage can ship in 1–2 weeks. Totems, LED facades and billboard structures typically run 4–8 weeks depending on structural engineering and permitting. You'll get a firm timeline after the design phase is signed off.

f2.question: Do you handle permits and municipal approvals?
f2.answer: Yes. For structures that require municipal sign-off — totems, billboards, rooftop signage — we prepare the technical documentation and manage the permitting process on your behalf.

f3.question: Can you match our existing brand guidelines exactly?
f3.answer: We work directly from your brand book, including Pantone-matched paint and vinyl, approved typefaces cut to spec, and consistent proportions across every location.

f4.question: What's included in the warranty?
f4.answer: Every project carries a structural warranty and a separate electronics warranty on LED components and drivers, typically 2–5 years depending on the product. Full terms are confirmed in your project quote.

f5.question: Do you work outside of Prishtinë?
f5.answer: Yes — our installation crews cover all of Kosovo and take on regional projects across the Balkans. Production stays centralised in our Prishtinë workshop for consistent quality control.

f6.question: Can you maintain signage after installation?
f6.answer: We offer scheduled maintenance contracts for LED and illuminated signage, covering module replacement, cleaning and structural inspection so your signage keeps performing years after installation.

AboutPage.storyTitle: From a small fabrication shop to the region's signage partner.
AboutPage.storyDescription: Pro Craft Reklama started as a two-person metalwork shop taking on whatever signage jobs came through the door. A decade later, we run a full production floor — metal fabrication, UV printing, LED assembly and vehicle wrap bays — serving retail groups, banks, logistics fleets and independent businesses across Kosovo and the wider Balkans.
AboutPage.storyParagraph: What hasn't changed is how we work: every project starts with a site visit, not a template. We'd rather turn down a rushed brief than deliver something that doesn't hold up to five years of weather, traffic and daily wear.

metro-retail-signage-rollout.title: Six-Location Signage Rollout
metro-retail-signage-rollout.summary: Standardised exterior and interior signage across six retail locations in under ten weeks.
metro-retail-signage-rollout.challenge: Metro Retail Group had grown through acquisition, inheriting six stores with six different signage standards. Their rebrand launch date was fixed, leaving no room for a slow rollout.
metro-retail-signage-rollout.solution: We built a single design system covering fascia signage, window graphics and interior wayfinding, then scheduled parallel production and phased installation crews across all six sites simultaneously.
metro-retail-signage-rollout.result: All six locations opened under a unified brand on launch day, with zero installation delays and consistent Pantone-matched finishes across every site.

nova-bank-led-facade.title: Landmark LED Facade
nova-bank-led-facade.summary: A programmable RGB facade display that turned a flagship branch into a recognisable city landmark.
nova-bank-led-facade.challenge: Nova Bank's flagship branch sat on a high-visibility corner but had no distinct identity after dark, losing impact against neighbouring illuminated storefronts.
nova-bank-led-facade.solution: We engineered a full-facade LED matrix with weatherproof modules and a remote content management system, allowing the bank's marketing team to update branding moments without site visits.
nova-bank-led-facade.result: The facade is now referenced as a city landmark in local press, with foot traffic past the branch increasing measurably after installation.

balkan-logistics-fleet-wrap.title: 40-Vehicle Fleet Branding
balkan-logistics-fleet-wrap.summary: Full cast-vinyl wraps applied across a 40-vehicle delivery fleet with zero colour variance.
balkan-logistics-fleet-wrap.challenge: Balkan Logistics needed their entire delivery fleet wrapped ahead of a regional expansion launch, with strict colour consistency across vehicles wrapped weeks apart.
balkan-logistics-fleet-wrap.solution: We built a colour-managed production pipeline with batch-matched vinyl stock and a dedicated climate-controlled wrap bay, scheduling vehicles in rotation to avoid fleet downtime.
balkan-logistics-fleet-wrap.result: All 40 vehicles were wrapped ahead of the launch date with verified colour consistency, and the fleet has since become the client's most-cited brand asset.
